findings.quote: On top of that, we have seen cyber attacks on companies and institutions, and we know that AI will multiply the threat.
findings.rationale: Identifies AI as amplifying cyber and information threats.

findings.quote: It is already speeding up cancer diagnosis in the UK, but AI has the potential to go further, not just to help prevent and treat cancer, but to help cure it.
findings.rationale: Introduces frontier AI as a priority and describes health applications.

findings.quote: I am announcing today that we are developing a new AI defense partnership with the United States to protect our critical national infrastructure.
findings.rationale: Announces AI security cooperation and a G20 AI focus while addressing AI risks, jobs, education and governance.

findings.quote: we will work towards agreeing a single set of global principles and standards to ensure the transparency and access we need to increase our preparedness and to ensure that AI development is safe.
findings.rationale: Proposes global AI safety standards and possible domestic legislation.
